title: Taking your responsibility in MTI one step further
description: Using your referral link and other business building tips. Sign up today: ...

asr.full_text: taking your responsibility in mirror trading international one step further if you are giving out your referral link this means you intend to build a team therefore your referrals are your responsibility when someone joins using your referral link it is your duty to follow up with that person if they have joined and funded their account welcome them to your business and ask them if they would like to be included into the WhatsApp group so they can get regular updates. Tell them about the video channel and ask them if they need assistance with anything. If they have joined and not yet funded their account, ask them if they are familiar with Bitcoin and if necessary, provide them with information to help them get started with Bitcoin. Assist them with funding their account, answer any questions they may have and forward any information they need. Remember to tell them about the video channel so they can get more information. I have people in my team whom I don't know what should I do? Congratulations! Your social media of viral marketing campaign is obviously working. To get the details of these people go to direct referrals and click Congratulations! Your social media viral marketing campaign is obviously working! To get the details of these people, go to Direct referrals and click on See Detailed Report. You will see a list of all the people who have joined using your referral link, you will find their email addresses listed, and their mobile number. In some cases you may need to go back to your Team Genealogy tree and click on to see which country they are from, and then try to figure out what the international number would be. Welcome them and follow the steps mentioned earlier in this video. Furthermore you can guide them in building a team of their own and this can often be done in conjunction with your sponsor. Remember this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom. If you have questions, or for more information please contact Clint.

textual.observation: The speaker instructs viewers who share a referral link to build a team, encourage referred people to join and fund accounts, and describes the business as a vehicle to reach financial freedom.

evidence.quote: if you are giving out your referral link this means you intend to build a team
if they have joined and funded their account
this is your opportunity to build a business that will be the vehicle that gets you to the land of financial freedom

textual.context: Promotional and instructional business-building context; the financial outcome is presented by the speaker and is not independently verified in these records.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised financial outcome is linked to recruiting through a referral link and to referred participants funding accounts, creating a relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual returns, fees, losses, coercion, or whether the business opportunity is legitimate. ASR may contain transcription errors.

textual.observation: The speaker directs a referrer to retrieve the email addresses and mobile numbers of people who joined through the referral link, contact them, and guide them toward account funding and further team-building.

evidence.quote: You will see a list of all the people who have joined using your referral link, you will find their email addresses listed, and their mobile number
Assist them with funding their account
you can guide them in building a team of their own

textual.context: Instructional referral-network context; the records do not clarify whether the listed individuals consented to this contact or data access.
textual.potential_relevance: Access to referred individuals' contact details and outreach is directly linked to recruitment and account funding, creating a data-and-action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish how the contact information was obtained, whether consent was given, what information was requested from individuals, or whether any account funding occurred.

visual.observation: The presentation shows a member-management interface with the labels "Direct Referrals 4," "Personally Referred Members," and a referral or binary genealogy tree containing members marked as paid or free.
visual.context: The screens are presented as part of a Mirror Trading International business or networking presentation.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible referral hierarchy and paid/free member statuses connect recruiting or maintaining referred members with a business-network structure, which conditionally merits review for the nature of the recruitment and payment relationship.
visual.limitations: These frames do not show the terms of payment, required fees, promised returns, or whether participation produced any actual outcome.

visual.observation: A slide labeled "Business Success" displays images of a luxury car and yacht alongside the Mirror Trading International branding, after slides showing referrals and team structures.
visual.context: The luxury images appear in a promotional presentation sequence following referral and team-management visuals.
visual.potential_relevance: The juxtaposition of aspirational luxury outcomes with referral and team-building materials may represent an implied business-success benefit associated with those activities, which conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not explicitly state that viewers will receive a car, yacht, income, or other return, and do not show eligibility requirements or substantiation.

visual_context_notes.observation: The material uses repeated Mirror Trading International branding and presents slides titled "Bitcoin," "Video Tutorials," "Teamwork," and "Questions."
The closing slide visibly provides a WhatsApp number and an email address under "QUESTIONS," alongside the phrases "BULL RUN" and "THE MOVEMENT IS REAL."

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a Mirror Trading International referral-based business by urging viewers to build a team, recruit people who fund accounts, and sign up through a referral link in pursuit of financial freedom. It also directs referrers to obtain members' contact details and help them fund accounts, establishing a concrete recruitment and money-flow mechanism. Although it does not state a specific guaranteed return, the records do not establish actual returns, losses, consent to contact, or completed transactions.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted financial outcome is tied to building a business through referral teams, including helping referred members fund accounts and guiding them to build teams of their own. The displayed binary genealogy tree supports a structured team relationship, although no commission formula is supplied.
